record.question: Reynold’s number is the ratio of inertia force to -
record.explanation: Reynolds number is the dimensionless ratio of inertial to viscous force, Re=ρVL/μ. Thus the denominator force in the question is viscous force. Reference: https://archive.nptel.ac.in/content/storage2/courses/101103004/module6/lec2/1.html. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
